> > For this it might make more sense to hook this into your search client itself. In rough terms this would be:
> >
> > ```js
> > const algoliaSearchClient = algolisearch('...', '...');
> >
> > const searchClient = {
> >   search: function(requests) {
> >     return algoliaSearchClient.search(requests).then(result => {
> >       // do your api call here
> >     })
> >   },
> >   searchForFacetValues: function(requests) {
> >     return algoliaSearchClient.searchForFacetValues(requests)
> >   }
> > };
> > ```
> >
> > You then pass `searchClient` as an argument to `instantsearch({ searchClient })`
